verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs include a page titled "Selecting an Audit Partner" under its Audits section, and the platform supports working with your auditor in-platform. That suggests a vendor-facilitated route to an auditor, but the evidence is only a page title and a one-line claim. Missing for 10: confirmation of a vetted auditor network or in-house audit arm, the ability to book the audit through Sprinto, published timeline expectations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
